arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Data from Treasury Bulletin - Public Debt to the Public (millions)
debt_1960 = 237177  # FY 1960
debt_1961 = 238604  # FY 1961
debt_1962 = 248373  # FY 1962

# BLS CPI-U annual averages (1982-84=100 base, not seasonally adjusted)
cpi_1960 = 29.6
cpi_1961 = 29.9
cpi_1962 = 30.2

# Adjust FY 1960 and FY 1961 debt to constant 1962 dollars
# Formula: Adjusted Value = Original Value × (Target CPI / Original CPI)

# FY 1960 adjusted to 1962 dollars
adjusted_1960 = debt_1960 * (cpi_1962 / cpi_1960)
print(f"FY 1960 debt: ${debt_1960:,.0f} million")
print(f"CPI 1960: {cpi_1960}")
print(f"Adjusted FY 1960 to 1962$: ${adjusted_1960:,.3f} million")
print()

# FY 1961 adjusted to 1962 dollars
adjusted_1961 = debt_1961 * (cpi_1962 / cpi_1961)
print(f"FY 1961 debt: ${debt_1961:,.0f} million")
print(f"CPI 1961: {cpi_1961}")
print(f"Adjusted FY 1961 to 1962$: ${adjusted_1961:,.3f} million")
print()

# Calculate absolute difference
difference = abs(adjusted_1961 - adjusted_1960)
print(f"Absolute difference: ${difference:,.3f} million")
print()
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {difference:.3f}")
EOF
